description: This file defines an interface 'TwigCallableInterface' in the Twig templating engine, which specifies methods for callable entities within Twig, including obtaining names, types, callables, arguments, and deprecation info.

classes.name: TwigCallableInterface
classes.description: An interface that enforces methods for callable objects in Twig templates, including metadata and characteristic methods.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the callable entity.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the callable entity.

methods.name: getDynamicName
methods.description: Returns the dynamic name associated with the callable, if any.

methods.name: getCallable
methods.description: Returns the actual callable, which could be a function, class method, or null.

methods.name: getNodeClass
methods.description: Returns the node class associated with this callable.

methods.name: needsCharset
methods.description: Indicates whether the callable needs a charset.

methods.name: needsEnvironment
methods.description: Indicates whether the callable needs the environment.

methods.name: needsContext
methods.description: Indicates whether the callable needs the context.

methods.name: withDynamicArguments
methods.description: Returns a new instance with dynamic arguments set.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Returns the arguments for the callable.

methods.name: isVariadic
methods.description: Checks if the callable accepts a variable number of arguments.

methods.name: isDeprecated
methods.description: Checks if the callable is marked as deprecated.

methods.name: getDeprecatingPackage
methods.description: Returns the package that marked the callable as deprecated.

methods.name: getDeprecatedVersion
methods.description: Returns the version when the callable was deprecated.

methods.name: getAlternative
methods.description: Returns an alternative suggested for the deprecated callable, if any.

methods.name: getMinimalNumberOfRequiredArguments
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of arguments required for the callable.
